businessStep.intro: Add the business by its GSTIN. The business is made from the PAN inside the GSTIN, and the registration is filled in from the GSTIN lookup where one is connected.
businessStep.gstinHelp: 15 characters, starting with the two-digit state code. The built-in static lookup of a local stack knows only the demo GSTIN 29ABCDE1234F1Z5; without a lookup provider nothing is filled in and a review task is opened instead.
businessStep.name: Business name
businessStep.nameHelp: The name the business goes by.
businessStep.registrationNameHelp: A name for this GSTIN, such as a branch; the business name when left empty.
businessStep.consentFirst: A business profile is processed on the strength of your consents. Record them on the consent step, then come back here.
businessStep.error.gstin: Enter the GSTIN as 15 characters: the two-digit state code, the PAN, the entity code, Z and a check character.
businessStep.error.name: Enter the name the business goes by.
prefill.applied: Stored on the profile from the GSTIN: {attributes}.
prefill.appliedNone: Nothing new was stored: the profile already held these values.
prefill.notLookedUpTitle: No lookup details for this GSTIN

consentSettings.intro: Each consent is a record with the version of the document it refers to and the time. Nothing here edits a record: giving or withdrawing adds a new one.
consentSettings.draft: {documents}. The wording has not been approved and may change; a record carries the version it refers to.
consentSettings.stateCaption: The latest record for each purpose
consentSettings.whatsappNotOffered: Set for each client business, not for the firm.
consentSettings.requiredNote: Terms of service, the privacy notice and processing of the business profile are what the service runs on. Withdrawing them ends the service, so it is a data rights request:
consentSettings.outdated: Given for an earlier version; the current one is {current}.
consentSettings.historyCaption: Your consent records, oldest first. They are append-only: a withdrawal is a new record, and earlier records stay as they were.
consentSettings.emptyTitle: No consent recorded for you yet
consentSettings.emptyBody: Nothing is on file for you. The terms, the privacy notice and profile processing are asked for when you get started.

consentSettings.recordsWithdraw: This adds a record for {purpose} with granted false, the notice version {notice} of the consent it withdraws, the source web_onboarding (the identity service has no settings source), you as the recorder, the sentence below as evidence, and the time. Earlier records stay as they are.
consentSettings.recordsGive: This adds a record for {purpose} with granted true, the notice version {notice}, the source web_onboarding (the identity service has no settings source), you as the recorder, the sentence below as evidence, and the time.
consentSettings.numberWithdrawHelp: With the country code, starting with +. The number is opted out on the notification service, so reminders to it stop. Leave it empty to record the withdrawal only; the number can also reply STOP.
consentSettings.numberGiveHelp: With the country code, starting with +. The notification service opts this number in once the consent is recorded.
consentSettings.error.purpose: This consent is not changed on this page.
consentSettings.error.change: Choose to give or to withdraw the consent.
consentSettings.error.optOutFailed: Nothing was recorded: the number could not be opted out.
consentSettings.error.recordAfterOptOut: The number is opted out, but the withdrawal is not recorded yet. Try again.
consentSettings.error.optInFailed: Your consent is recorded, but the number is not opted in yet. Try again.
consentSettings.error.closed: Consents cannot be given while the legal documents are drafts; nothing was recorded. Withdrawing a consent always works.
consentSettings.done.alreadyWithdrawn: {purpose} was not given, so nothing new was recorded.
consentSettings.done.alreadyGiven: {purpose} was already given for the current version, so nothing new was recorded.
notifications.intro: Whether reminders reach a WhatsApp number or an email address, in which language, and the quiet hours in Indian Standard Time when they are held. Each preference is kept by the notification service for one number or address.

notifications.recipientHelp.whatsapp: With the country code, starting with +.
notifications.recipientHelp.email: The address the reminders go to.
notifications.consentGiven: Your consent to {purpose} is on file.
notifications.consentNotGiven: Your consent to {purpose} is not on file, so reminders cannot be switched on here.
notifications.consentMissing: Give the consent first; the service opts a recipient in only once it is recorded. Switching reminders off and changing the language or the quiet hours work without it.
notifications.emailNote: The notification service does not deliver email yet: its email channel is not connected. A preference is still recorded and applies once it is.
notifications.notRecordedTitle: Nothing is recorded for this recipient
notifications.notRecorded: The notification service sends nothing to a recipient that is not opted in. The form starts from the service's defaults: English, and quiet hours from 21:00 to 08:00 IST.
notifications.languageHelp: The languages the service has message templates in for this channel.
notifications.quietHelp: A reminder due in this window is held and sent when it ends. A window may run past midnight; the same start and end means no quiet hours.
notifications.error.emailMissing: Enter the address the reminders go to.
notifications.error.email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
notifications.error.language: Choose one of the languages listed.
notifications.error.time: Enter a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock.
notifications.error.consentMissing: Your consent to {purpose} is not on file, so reminders were not switched on. Give it on the Consents page, or choose not to send reminders.
notifications.error.consentMissingField: Reminders can be switched on once your consent is on file.
